connection.text: Connection Name*Give your connection a unique name to help you identify it in the future.Endpoint URL*Provide the ArgoCD server API endpoint. E.g. https://argocd.example.com/api/v1Bearer Token*Provide your ArgoCD API token for authentication. Learn how to generate a tokenProxyAdd a proxy if you cannot access ArgoCD directly.Custom Rate LimitBy default, DevLake uses 3,000 requests/hour for data collection for ArgoCD. You can adjust the collection speed by setting your desired rate limit.

scopeConfig.text: CI/CDDeploymentDORAUse Regular Expressions to define how DevLake identifies deployments and production environments from ArgoCD sync operations to measure DORA metrics.Environment DetectionAn ArgoCD sync operation is a 'Production Deployment' when the application name matches*Optional FiltersDeployment Pattern (filter sync operations by application name)Production Pattern (additional pattern for production detection)Note: ArgoCD limits deployment history to the last 10 sync operations by default (controlled by revisionHistoryLimit). Consider increasing this value in your ArgoCD application settings for better historical metrics.
